payload.credit_html: Here Fishy Fishy Fishy (194/365)
payload.description_html:
A large tuna jumps out of the Atlantic Ocean off the coast of Maine. We are on a whale watching boat, but not seeing many whales. In the end, this fish was the highlight of the trip.

This has to be among my luckiest shots ever. I saw some activity over in this area and set the focus accordingly. I saw this crest out of the water and held down the shutter to capture a few frames before it went back in. I did have to crop in a bit, and was delighted to see that I managed to get this as well as I did.
